verified_signals.implies: Branch contraction is real and large over 18 months (388 -> 334) but is NOT currently accelerating: zero net closures in Q2-2026. verified_signals.entity: National Bank of Romania (BNR) - operational and security incidents at payment service providers
verified_signals.signal: BNR's June-2026 Financial Stability Report (section 4.3, p.92) reports that in H2-2025 nine payment service providers notified 15 major operational incidents and one major security incident under DORA (Regulation EU 2022/2554, the EU's digital operational resilience rules for finance), of which two were later reclassified as non-major. The disclosed impacts were unavailability or degraded performance of: card payment initiation including cash withdrawal AND DEPOSIT operations ('imposibilitatea utilizarii cardurilor la terminale POS/ATM'), settlement of authorised payments, payment acceptance, and user authentication in banking apps. The average number of payment users affected per major incident was about 22,000 and the average number of payment operations affected about 33,300. None affected services in other Member States.
verified_signals.source_name: Banca Nationala a Romaniei, Raport asupra stabilitatii financiare, iunie 2026, section 4.3
verified_signals.implies: The central bank is now publishing DORA incident statistics that name ATM/POS unavailability - for deposits as well as withdrawals - as a primary customer-visible failure mode. That directly raises the value of self-service availability monitoring, multivendor ATM management software and managed services carrying contractual uptime, and of fraud-monitoring and HSM refresh across Romanian banks including BRD. Deposit-side failures are the strongest hook, because they are exactly what a recycler estate has to get right.
verified_signals.likelihood: High - DORA incident reporting is now a standing semi-annual regulatory cycle
verified_signals.followup: Use BNR's own DORA incident wording as the framing for an availability-SLA managed-services pitch to BRD and Romanian peers. Track the December-2026 FSR for the H1-2026 incident numbers.
verified_signals.verifier_note: Extracted the 119-page BNR PDF locally with pdfminer and read section 4.3 in the Romanian original. Every incident figure confirmed verbatim: '15 incidente operationale majore si un incident de securitate major de catre noua prestatori de servicii de plata (PSP), din care doua au fost reclasificate ca non-majore'; the four impact categories including 'operatiuni de retragere/depunere de numerar (imposibilitatea utilizarii cardurilor la terminale POS/ATM)'; and 'Numarul mediu de utilizatori de servicii de plata afectati de incidentele majore... a fost de aproximativ 22.000, iar numarul mediu al operatiunilor de plata afectate a fost de aproximativ 33.300'.
